leadText: Chiaki Takahashi (Japanese: たかはし智秋 Takahashi Chiaki) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Chiaki Takahashi (Japanese: たかはし智秋 Takahashi Chiaki) is a Japanese voice actress for .

== Biography ==
Takahashi was born on May 8, 1977 in , . Takahashi started her work in during the beginning of . Her most notable role is that of the Officer Jennys of Unova. To date, she has not had any further roles after the end of the Black & White series.
